name: 半枚棋子 · 学徒版 VOL.6
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP7M《半枚棋子·学徒版》语法命门 12 题，按 R / SR / SSR 三档标注难度。本卷的看图命门（13–17）、传记阅读（18–20）、对白填空、时间线排序依赖纸面漫画分镜页，未进题库。

m5.q: When the two ___ of the piece came together, they fitted exactly.
m5.why: half 以 -f 结尾，变复数把 f 改成 v 再加 -es → halves；two 后面必须用复数。

m5.q: Duo ___ already set the board when Yu walked in.
m5.why: 摆好棋在“他走进来”之前就完成了，用过去完成时 had + 过去分词。

m5.q: He found the half piece ___ the bottom of a dry well.
m5.why: at the bottom of 是固定搭配，表示“在……的底部”。

m5.q: ___ quietly Duo waited for those two months!
m5.why: 感叹的中心是副词 quietly（修饰 waited），用 How + 副词。

m5.q: Nobody in the school knows ___ Yue is now — in the north, in the sea, nobody can say.
m5.why: 从句缺的是地点（她现在在哪儿），用 where 引导宾语从句。

m5.q: The well was ___ deeper than he had thought.
m5.why: much 可以修饰比较级，表示“……得多”。同类的还有 far / a lot / even。

m5.q: Yu reached into his pocket ___ the other half of the piece.
m5.why: 表示目的用动词不定式 to do。

m5.q: ___ he had waited for two whole months, Duo did not say a word about it.
m5.why: 前后是让步关系（虽然等了两个月，却一个字没提），用 Though 引导让步状语从句。

m5.q: Nobody helped him. He dug at the wet floor and found it ___.
m5.why: 强调“他自己缈亲自）”找到的，用反身代词 himself。

m5.q: Yu ___ such an opening before — this is the first time he has met it.
m5.why: never…before 讲的是“到现在为止从未”，用现在完成时。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: Though he had waited two months, but he said nothing.
The two halves of the piece fitted together.
He counted the days by the light above him.
Nobody has ever explained how she went.
m5.why: though 与 but 不能同时出现，去掉 but → Though he had waited two months, he said nothing.

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: He reached into his pocket to take something out.
The board was set up by Duo every afternoon, isn't it?
The well was much deeper than it looked.
She has been gone for two months.
m5.why: 前半句是一般过去时的被动 was set up，反意疑问要跟着用 wasn't it。
